QUOTE: "writes the post to WatermelonDB before the network call, keyed by a pending ID (`${userId}:${timestamp}`). If `client.createPost` throws, it rewrites that record with `props.failed = true`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is written to the local DB (WatermelonDB) before sending, and on failure it is kept and marked `failed = true`.
